speaker: Unknown
en: All right.
zh: 好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hello, everybody.
zh: 大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: My name is Cody.
zh: 我叫 Cody。

speaker: Unknown
en: I put this picture up here because this jacket so far has not actually landed as well as I thought it would.
zh: 我把这张图放上来,是因为这件夹克到目前为止的反响还不如我预想的好。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one gets the joke.
zh: 没有人看懂这个梗。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this was to really put it in front of your face.
zh: 所以这次是真的要把它怼到你脸上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't just enjoy wearing heavily branded Letterman jackets.
zh: 我可不只是喜欢穿这种印满标识的徳式学生夹克。

speaker: Unknown
en: We intentionally tried to...
zh: 我们是刻意想……

speaker: Unknown
en: Play into the bit a little bit.
zh: 有点玩梗的意思。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my name's Cody.
zh: 我叫 Cody。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm on the growth team at Firecrawl.
zh: 我在 Firecrawl 的增长团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And today I'm here to tell you you're not thinking big enough.
zh: 今天我在这里要告诉你:你想得不够大。

speaker: Unknown
en: But before I actually get into that, I have to address a bit of an elephant in the room, which is Theo stole my talk.
zh: 但在我真正开始之前,我得先说一件显而易见的事,那就是 Theo 偷了我的演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Theo put out a video about a month ago called You Need to Think Bigger.
zh: Theo 大约一个月前发了一个视频,叫《你需要想得更大》。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I would like to say I submitted the name for this talk a month before Theo put his video out.
zh: 但我想说,我提交这个演讲题目比 Theo 发视频早了一个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't steal his talk.
zh: 我没有偷他的演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: He stole my talk.
zh: 是他偷了我的演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, we're actually going to talk about farming.
zh: 今天,我们实际上要聊的是农业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yes, I actually mean farming.
zh: 对,我真的说的是农业。

speaker: Unknown
en: More specifically, I mean livestock farming.
zh: 更具体地说,我说的是畜牧养殖。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even more specifically, I mean automating pasture rotation for grass-fed livestock systems.
zh: 再更具体地说,我说的是为草饲畜牧系统自动化牧场轮换。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have a feeling most of you did not expect to learn about cows and grass and farming today, but I'm here, so you're going to.
zh: 我有种感觉,你们大多数人今天没指望学到关于牛、草和农业的东西,但我都来了,所以你们就得听。

speaker: Unknown
en: A little bit of background on who I am and why maybe you should listen to me.
zh: 先简单介绍一下我是谁,以及为什么你们也许该听我讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: The short version is I actually have no credentials that qualify me for this talk, but nonetheless, I'm gonna do my best to give it.
zh: 简短版本是:我其实没有任何够格做这场演讲的资历,但尽管如此,我还是会尽力讲好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I grew up in Kentucky, have a background in blue-collar work.
zh: 我在肯塔基州长大,有蓝领工作的背景。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was a bartender, a mechanic,
zh: 我做过调酒师、修车工,

speaker: Unknown
en: Server, a whole bunch of things.
zh: 服务员,还有一大堆别的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Never actually a farmer though.
zh: 不过从来没真正当过农民。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I sort of found my way into engineering, software development, et cetera.
zh: 后来我算是找到了自己的路,进了工程、软件开发之类的领域。

speaker: Unknown
en: I actually don't really like taking the title of software engineer.
zh: 我其实不太喜欢用软件工程师这个头衔。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm pretty adverse to that.
zh: 我对此相当抵触。

speaker: Unknown
en: Feels like stolen valor because I am the vibe coder most of you all are scared of.
zh: 那感觉像是冒领军功,因为我是你们大多数人所害怕的那种 vibe coder。

speaker: Unknown
en: I use AI agents all day long.
zh: 我整天都在用 AI 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't have any syntax memorized.
zh: 我没有任何语法是背下来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am not proficient in any particular coding language, but I will crank out some stuff on a weekend.
zh: 我不精通任何一门特定的编程语言,但我能在周末搞出一些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But today I actually work at Firecrawl where we're building context for AI agents.
zh: 但今天我实际上在 Firecrawl 工作,我们在为 AI 智能体构建上下文。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a series of web data APIs to give your agents access to the web.
zh: 我们有一系列 web 数据 API,让你的智能体能访问互联网。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, I said I'm on the growth team, but today we're actually going to get into some more farming stuff.
zh: 再说一次,我说过我在增长团队,但今天我们实际上要聊更多农业的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: But first, a bit of credential I do have is this is a real picture of me hauling turkeys on top of my Tesla, and I do still have a crack in that glass ceiling because of it.
zh: 不过先说一个我确实有的资历:这是一张真实的照片,是我在我的特斯拉车顶上运火鸡,而且正因为如此,那块玻璃车顶到现在还有一道裂痕。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was in Nashville where I lived in the middle of a residential neighborhood where you are not allowed to raise turkeys.
zh: 那是在纳什维尔,当时我住在一片住宅区正中间,那里是不允许养火鸡的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I raised 10 turkeys in my backyard because I wanted to know what it was like to actually raise livestock myself that I would eat.
zh: 但我在自家后院养了 10 只火鸡,因为我想知道亲自养殖自己要吃的牲畜是什么感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a very mentally...
zh: 这在心理上是非常……

speaker: Unknown
en: Difficult process, to be totally honest.
zh: 说实话,是很艰难的过程。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this was me loading them up onto the roof of my Tesla, and then I drove for three hours with them to the processor, had to stop at a supercharger on the way, and lots of people were taking pictures.
zh: 但这就是我把它们装上特斯拉车顶的照片,然后我开了三个小时车送它们去加工厂,路上还得在一个超充站停下,很多人都在拍照。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what I can tell you is, is your range is sufficiently decreased when you have a giant windbreak full of turkeys on top of the roof.
zh: 我可以告诉你的是,当车顶上有一大排挡风的火鸡时,你的续航会明显下降。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was quite the anxious drive, I can tell you.
zh: 所以那真是一趟焦虑的驾驶,我可以这么说。

speaker: Unknown
en: I also almost left engineering to be a farmer.
zh: 我还差一点为了当农民而离开工程行业。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really wanted to raise chickens.
zh: 我真的很想养鸡。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a real product image that I came up with.
zh: 这是我自己做出来的一个真实产品图。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to wrap turkeys in white wrapping and literally just slap the word EE on top of it.
zh: 我想把火鸡用白色包装纸包起来,然后直接在上面印上 EE 这个词。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought it was provocative.
zh: 我觉得这个想法很有挑衅性。

speaker: Unknown
en: I thought I would get you to buy chickens.
zh: 我本来还以为能让你们去买鸡呢。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I realized it's actually really hard to make any money farming.
zh: 但我意识到，靠种地赚钱其实真的很难。

speaker: Unknown
en: Surprise, surprise.
zh: 毫不意外。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I have a wife.
zh: 而且我有妻子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have two kids.
zh: 我有两个孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: It didn't feel right to ask them to give up the lives they had so that I could go cosplay as a farmer and raise chickens.
zh: 让他们放弃原有的生活，好让我去玩儿“扮演农民”、养鸡，这感觉不对。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I decided to pivot and see if there were ways that we could scale farming itself and the types of systems that I'm interested in when it comes to livestock agriculture.
zh: 所以我决定转向，看看有没有办法能把畜牧业本身、以及我在畜牧农业方面感兴趣的各类系统进行规模化。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, three things I want to get accomplished in this talk is, one, convince you all to pursue bigger ideas.
zh: 所以，这场演讲我想完成三件事：第一，说服你们所有人去追求更大的想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think a lot of these talks, a lot of these conferences, a lot of us individually spend a lot of time talking about building software for people who build software, for people who build software, so on and so forth.
zh: 我觉得很多这样的演讲、很多这样的会议、我们中的很多人，花了太多时间在讨论“为构建软件的人构建软件，再为构建软件的人构建软件”，如此循环往复。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I really am just here to challenge you that there are other problems to solve than just another MCP for another SaaS solution at another company.
zh: 而我今天来真的就是想挑战你们：除了在又一家公司为另一个 SaaS 方案再做又一个 MCP 之外，还有其他问题值得解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: But also, I'm just really trying to take advantage of a captive audience.
zh: 不过，我也确实是在充分利用一批“被囚禁的听众”。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you corner me anywhere at any time, there's a good chance I will talk to you about farming.
zh: 如果你在任何时间、任何地点把我堵住，我很可能会跟你聊农业。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, here I am.
zh: 所以，我来了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And hopefully I can convince you to come work at Firecrawl.
zh: 希望我能说服你们来 Firecrawl 工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, first things first, I believe livestock belongs on pasture.
zh: 好，先说第一件事：我相信牲畜应该待在牧场上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think animals should live on grass.
zh: 我认为动物应该生活在草地上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's better for the animal, the consumer, the farmer, the ecosystem.
zh: 我认为这对动物、消费者、农民、生态系统都更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can give you a whole TED Talk on each of those if I need to.
zh: 如果需要，关于其中每一点我都能给你做一整场 TED 演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can find me later if you need me to tell you why it's better for animals to be on grass, but I don't have enough time to get into all of that.
zh: 如果你需要我告诉你为什么动物待在草地上更好，稍后可以来找我，但我没有足够的时间展开讲所有这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take my word for it.
zh: 相信我。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start there.
zh: 我们从这里开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: The assumption is animals should be on grass.
zh: 前提假设是：动物应该待在草地上。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the goal I want to hit.
zh: 这就是我想达成的目标。

speaker: Unknown
en: I am not actually anti-containment farming.
zh: 我其实并不是反对圈养式养殖。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think there's a reason we needed to do that.
zh: 我认为我们当初这么做是有原因的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But 97% of cows are still currently finished on feedlots.
zh: 但目前仍有 97% 的牛是在饲养场完成育肥的。

speaker: Unknown
en: 3% are raised on pasture.
zh: 只有 3% 是在牧场上饲养的。

speaker: Unknown
en: My opinion here, more animals could be on grass.
zh: 我的看法是：可以有更多的动物待在草地上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I want to try to figure out how we get more animals on grass.
zh: 我想弄清楚我们怎样才能让更多动物上草地。

speaker: Unknown
en: The question is, why aren't they on grass?
zh: 问题是：为什么它们没在草地上？

speaker: Unknown
en: And that is, labor is the bottleneck.
zh: 答案是：劳动力是瓶颈。

speaker: Unknown
en: It is a pain in the ass to actually raise animals on grass.
zh: 在草地上真正把动物养起来是一件极其麻烦的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pasture done right actually means moving animals constantly, and that takes a lot of work.
zh: 把牧场做对了，实际上意味着要不停地移动动物，而这需要大量的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you think about grass-fed beef, you might think of, I have 100 cows, 100 acres, I put 100 cows on 100 acres, they eat grass, I got beef at the end of the year.
zh: 说到草饲牛肉，你可能会想：我有 100 头牛、100 英亩地，我把 100 头牛放到 100 英亩地上，它们吃草，年底我就有牛肉了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not quite how it works.
zh: 实际情况并不是这样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You will very rapidly decrease the quality of your pasture if you just let cows graze where they want because they'll graze their favorite things, ignore things that they shouldn't, trample areas consistently, so on and so forth.
zh: 如果你放任牛群想在哪儿吃就在哪儿吃，你的牧场质量会迅速下降，因为它们只吃自己爱吃的东西，忽略不该忽略的东西，反复踩踏某些区域，等等等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the solution to that is rotational grazing.
zh: 解决这个问题的办法是轮牧。

speaker: Unknown
en: What this means is you break up your pasture into individual paddocks where the animals have enough food for one day and then you move them every single day.
zh: 意思是，你把牧场划分成一个个单独的围栏区，每个区里的食物够动物吃一天，然后你每天移动它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: This allows certain areas to rest and other areas to be grazed and over time will increase the efficacy of your pasture.
zh: 这样某些区域得以休养，另一些区域被放牧，随着时间推移会提高你牧场的效能。

speaker: Unknown
en: This takes a whole, whole, whole lot of work.
zh: 而这需要非常多、非常多、非常多的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: This means you have to move fences, animals, water and keep track of it every single day in order to appropriately move the animals as often as they need to.
zh: 这意味着你每天都要移动围栏、动物、水，并做好记录，以便按照需要的频率妥善移动动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are some solutions actually trying to work on this problem.
zh: 实际上有一些方案正在尝试解决这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You may have seen a company called Holter in the news recently.
zh: 你可能最近在新闻里见过一家叫 Holter 的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: Peter Thiel invested at a $2 billion valuation.
zh: Peter Thiel 以 20 亿美元的估值进行了投资。

speaker: Unknown
en: NoFence is another company.
zh: NoFence 是另一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: What these companies do is provide collars for the animals connected to GPS satellites that allow you to draw virtual boundaries where you can move the animals remotely.
zh: 这些公司做的事情是为动物提供连接 GPS 卫星的项圈，让你可以画出虚拟边界，从而远程移动动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think this is a great step in the direction of trying to expand labor, but this has a problem, which is you have to know where to move the animals.
zh: 我认为这是在扩展劳动力方向上很棒的一步，但这有一个问题：你得知道该把动物移到哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is not a science, to actually be honest with you.
zh: 老实跟你说，这并不是一门精确的科学。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can't just move them in a straight line across the pasture routinely every single day to the same part of land.
zh: 你不能每天机械地把它们沿着同一条直线在牧场上移到同一块地上。

speaker: Unknown
en: The reason is, is grass doesn't grow the same every single day.
zh: 原因是,草每天的生长情况都不一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are drought conditions, rainfall,
zh: 有干旱情况、降雨量,

speaker: Unknown
en: How much impact a particular section of the paddock has had and the way that this is sold today is actually farmers going out on pasture putting eyeballs on the grass and making intuitive decisions about where the next best move should be.
zh: 牧场的某个特定区域受到了多少影响,而如今这种东西的售卖方式实际上是农民走到牧草地上,用眼睛观察草,然后凭直觉决定下一个最佳移动位置应该在哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the question is how do we replace the farmers eyes on pasture so that they can remotely make educated decisions on where to move their virtual fences?
zh: 所以问题是,我们如何取代农民在牧场上的眼睛,让他们能够远程做出有依据的决策,决定把他们的虚拟围栏移到哪里?

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a bit more that actually goes into this as well, and that is you can't just, you have to also know how tall the grass is.
zh: 实际上这里面还有更多因素,那就是你还必须知道草有多高。

speaker: Unknown
en: Grass has a growing cycle.
zh: 草有一个生长周期。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you grow it way too short, it takes a really long time to come back.
zh: 如果你把它割得太短,它需要很长时间才能长回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you let it go too long, it becomes old and bitter and the animals don't like it.
zh: 如果你让它长太久,它就会变老变苦,动物就不喜欢了。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's this juvenile sweet spot that you want to keep the grass in.
zh: 有一个幼年期的最佳区间,你要让草保持在这个区间里。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want to cut it before it gets too tall, but then you also don't want to cut it too short.
zh: 你想在它长得太高之前割掉它,但你也不想把它割得太短。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to keep the animals moving and then constantly coming back to the same pasture.
zh: 你需要让动物不断移动,然后不断回到同一片牧场。

speaker: Unknown
en: So your grass stays at the most optimal growing age and constantly has the most productivity possible.
zh: 这样你的草就能保持在最佳生长年龄,并且持续拥有尽可能最高的生产力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a couple of ways that we can do this.
zh: 所以有几种方法可以做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are things, these are my solutions.
zh: 这些是,这些是我的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is something I've actually been working on, thinking about how we can do this.
zh: 这是我实际上一直在研究的东西,思考我们如何做到这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: A couple of options that I have are drone orthomosaic maps.
zh: 我有的几个选项是无人机正射影像图。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we could find a way to automate drone flights, we could go fly them around our pasture, take a whole bunch of pictures, get some very high fidelity, high resolution images of the grass that farmers could analyze.
zh: 如果我们能找到一种自动化无人机飞行的方法,我们就可以让它们在我们的牧场上空飞行,拍摄大量照片,获得一些非常高的保真度、高分辨率的草的图像,供农民分析。

speaker: Unknown
en: The problem with this is there's a lot of skilled upgrade you need to do with the farmers to teach them how to fly drones, a lot of regulatory issues with keeping the drones in sight, and ideally this would be autonomous, and there currently isn't a jurisdiction in the world that has approved autonomous drones for these types of applications.
zh: 这个方法的问题在于,需要对农民进行大量的技能升级,教他们如何驾驶无人机,让无人机保持在视线内还有很多监管问题,理想情况下这应该是自主的,而目前世界上还没有任何一个司法管辖区批准自主无人机用于这类应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a really big bottleneck.
zh: 所以这是一个非常大的瓶颈。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it has pretty high fidelity in the quality of imagery but is gonna be a hard problem to solve in terms of actually getting all those hurdles accomplished.
zh: 我认为它在图像质量上有相当高的保真度,但要真正克服所有这些障碍,会是一个很难解决的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Satellites is my most favorite option today.
zh: 卫星是我目前最喜欢的选项。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a really cool company called Planet out there taking pictures of the entire globe every single day with a
zh: 有一家非常酷的公司叫 Planet,每天用一张

speaker: Unknown
en: One by one meter resolution, but there's still, those satellites are really high up in the sky, and it's hard to tell some of the things you need to tell to actually make those educated decisions.
zh: 一米乘一米分辨率拍摄整个地球的照片,但仍然,那些卫星在天上非常高,很难分辨出你为做出那些有依据的决策所需要分辨的一些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: The middle photo here is actually from a friend of mine out in Missouri working as a research grad assistant at the Missouri Lincoln University, and this idea is just putting a trail cam next to a tree and some measuring apparatus that that camera can look at,
zh: 这里的中间这张照片实际上来自我的一位朋友,他在密苏里林肯大学担任研究助理,这个想法只是把一个追踪相机放在树旁边,再加上一些该相机可以看到的测量装置,

speaker: Unknown
en: We're figuring out how tall is the grass in relation to that particular object, just so that we have some sort of reference point that we can use to see how well the grass is growing back.
zh: 我们要弄清楚草相对于那个特定物体有多高,这样我们就有了某种参考点,可以用来观察草长回来的情况有多好。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we can solve this problem, along with the caller situation, I think there's a world here where we can drop an LLM in the middle of this loop and start to work on autonomous grazing operations.
zh: 如果我们能解决这个问题,连同项圈的问题,我认为存在这样一个世界:我们可以把一个 LLM 放进这个循环的中间,开始研究自主放牧作业。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what this would mean is an LLM essentially making the next best decision on where the animal should be any given day.
zh: 这意味着的是一个 LLM 基本上在为动物任何给定的一天应该在哪里做出下一个最佳决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is a multivariate analysis.
zh: 这是一个多变量分析。

speaker: Unknown
en: This requires the LLive to have several data inputs, including where the animals are in GPS location, where they were yesterday, where they might go tomorrow, what the drought condition is in the area, how tall the grass is across the entire farm.
zh: 这需要 LLive 有多个数据输入,包括动物的 GPS 位置在哪里、它们昨天在哪里、它们明天可能去哪里、该地区的干旱状况如何、整个农场的草有多高。

speaker: Unknown
en: And actually it has to make this decision not just on a day-to-day basis but in varying degrees of relation.
zh: 而且实际上它不仅要逐日地做出这个决策,还要在不同程度的关系上做出这个决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: So where's the best next place for a particular cow to be?
zh: 所以,某头特定的牛的下一个最佳位置在哪里?

speaker: Unknown
en: But where's the best place for the herd to be in relationship to the pasture itself, in relationship to the farm as a whole?
zh: 但牛群的最佳位置在哪里,相对于牧场本身,相对于整个农场?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then more broadly the ecosystem at large.
zh: 然后更广泛地说,相对于整个生态系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's all of these components feed back into each other and if you can optimize this entire picture you have a more productive farm where you can actually have more animals on fewer acres which is how we end up actually scaling to compete with the feedlot style where you can actually have more cows on fewer grass.
zh: 所有这些组成部分相互反馈,如果你能优化这整幅图景,你就拥有了一个更高产的农场,你实际上可以在更少的英亩上养更多动物,这正是我们最终真正实现规模化、与饲养场模式竞争的方式,那样你就可以在更少的草地上养更多牛。

speaker: Unknown
en: How do we solve this problem?
zh: 我们如何解决这个问题?

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a couple of components.
zh: 有几个组成部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's three main blockers that I think need to exist in order for us to actually create this system.
zh: 有三个主要阻碍,我认为要让真正创建出这个系统,它们必须被解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first one is building a knowledge base, and this is primarily what I'm working on at Firecrawl, and then an open source project I have called OpenPasture.
zh: 第一个是构建知识库,这主要就是我在 Firecrawl 从事的工作,还有一个我开发的开源项目 OpenPasture。

speaker: Unknown
en: The idea here is a lot of the knowledge on when to move, why to move, how to move, the benefits of moving, et cetera, is all locked up in primarily YouTube videos.
zh: 这里的想法是,很多关于何时移动、为什么移动、如何移动、移动的好处等等的知识,全都被锁在主要是 YouTube 视频里。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a bunch of really cool farmers out there.
zh: 有很多非常酷的农民。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can give you a whole bunch of channels that you can go down rabbit holes on of just good old guys out in Missouri, Tennessee, Kentucky, trying to move their animals every single day, telling you what they're learning, telling you what species are best for this, what lagoons you want to aim for in the biodiversity and your pasture.
zh: 我可以给你一大堆频道,你可以钻进去深挖,都是密苏里、田纳西、肯塔基那些善良的老伙计们,每天试着移动他们的动物,告诉你他们学到了什么,告诉你哪些物种最适合这样做,你在牧场的生物多样性方面应该瞄准哪些滞水塘。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a whole bunch of things that go into this, and we need to build that knowledge base.
zh: 这里面有一大堆因素,我们需要构建那个知识库。

speaker: Unknown
en: Firecrawl is a toolkit that I use to actually collect this data, going out, scraping those YouTube videos, scraping research papers out to archive, building this knowledge base up, and OpenPasture is the actual repository I put this information in to make it available to any farmer I think that might be able to use it.
zh: Firecrawl 是我用来实际收集这些数据的工具包,出去抓取那些 YouTube 视频,抓取存档中的研究论文,把这个知识库构建起来,而 OpenPasture 是我存放这些信息的实际仓库,以便让任何我认为可能能够使用它的农民都可以使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next thing to solve is the actual visualization layer.
zh: 接下来要解决的是实际的可视化层。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot of components we need to know about the grass that the farmer's primarily getting out of the intuition from looking at the pasture.
zh: 关于草,有很多我们需要知道的组成部分,而农民目前主要是通过观察牧场获得的直觉来获取的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The two main things worth figuring out about the pasture, both where the animals are, where they should go, and where you want them to be,
zh: 关于牧场值得弄清楚的两件主要的事,既包括动物在哪里、它们应该去哪里,以及你想让它们在哪里,

speaker: Unknown
en: is what is the biomass?
zh: 是生物量是多少?

speaker: Unknown
en: How much foliage actually is available for them to consume?
zh: 实际有多少可供它们食用的植被?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then long term, what is the biodiversity of that particular pasture?
zh: 然后长期来看,那个特定牧场的生物多样性是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: If they overgraze sections too heavily, they'll start to over-index on different types of cool season, warm season grasses, legumes, et cetera.
zh: 如果它们对某些区域过度放牧得太厉害,就会开始过度偏向不同类型的冷季草、暖季草、豆科植物等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And ideally, you want a really rounded, really diverse pasture over time to make sure that the
zh: 理想情况下，随着时间推移，你会想要一片非常均衡、非常多样的牧场，以确保

speaker: Unknown
en: Cattle are getting the nutrients they need, so you don't have to supplement with things like hay, copper, aluminum, etc.
zh: 牛群能获得所需的营养，这样你就不必用干草、铜、铝等东西来补充。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ideally, they get all of the macronutrients and micronutrients from the grass itself, which becomes an entirely, ideally, hands-off system.
zh: 理想情况下，它们从草本身获得所有宏量营养素和微量营养素，这就会成为一个完全的、理想情况下无需人工干预的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the third one is, those geofence companies, so NoFence, Halter, while I appreciate the technology they're trying to push forward, I have a pretty strong disagreement with them, which is, in order to use their software, they require you buy their callers, and you can't plug your own software into their callers.
zh: 然后第三个是，那些虚拟围栏公司，比如 NoFence、Halter，虽然我很欣赏它们 trying 推动的技术，但我与它们有一个相当强烈的分歧，那就是，为了使用它们的软件，它们要求你购买它们的 callers，而你无法把自己的软件接入它们的 callers。

speaker: Unknown
en: From a business standpoint, I get why this is.
zh: 从商业角度来看，我理解为什么会这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: From an industry standpoint, I think it's really a pain in the ass.
zh: 但从行业角度来看，我认为这真的很让人头疼。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to innovate on the software layer.
zh: 我想在软件层面进行创新。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to push GPS locations to these callers that my LLM can predict.
zh: 我想把我的 LLM 能预测的 GPS 位置推送到这些 callers 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't want to have to rely on their software to do this because I don't think it's as good or I think I can make it better.
zh: 我不想依赖它们的软件来做这件事，因为我认为它不够好，或者说我认为自己能做得更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm being totally honest with you.
zh: 我跟你们说的是完全实话。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a bit of the purpose of this talk is actually a call to action for you all in the audience.
zh: 所以这次演讲的一个目的，实际上是对在座各位的一个行动号召。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need someone to make me a caller.
zh: 我需要有人给我做一个 caller。

speaker: Unknown
en: I need it to be open.
zh: 我需要它是开放的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The APIs need to be open.
zh: API 需要是开放的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ideally, it's an off-the-shelf solution.
zh: 理想情况下，它是一个现成的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some component parts that we can slap together.
zh: 一些我们可以拼装起来的组件部件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Farmers are pretty scrappy and like to heal their own things.
zh: 农民是很能将就的，喜欢自己修理东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot of animosity towards John Deere and this sort of like right to repair.
zh: 人们对 John Deere 以及这种所谓的维修权有很多敌意。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my ask to anyone maybe looking at this problem is design me a caller where the patent can be open and the APIs are open so that we can compete on software and optimize this solution.
zh: 所以我对任何可能在研究这个问题的人的请求是：给我设计一个专利可以开放、API 也开放的 caller，这样我们就能在软件上竞争并优化这个方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next thing I'd like to maybe tease you about is this actually goes beyond just ruminants.
zh: 接下来我想跟你们预告的是，这实际上不仅仅局限于反刍动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: So ruminants is a type of animal, cows, sheep, goats, those are all ruminant animals.
zh: 反刍动物是一种动物类型，牛、绵羊、山羊，这些都是反刍动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: They chew grass, they digest it in their ruminant, which is an organ, that's why they're called ruminants.
zh: 它们咀嚼草，在自己的 ruminant（瘤胃）——那是一个器官——里消化它，这就是它们被称为反刍动物的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: But there's actually an additional benefit we get where we can stack species on these pasture rotations.
zh: 但实际上还有一个额外的好处，我们可以在这些牧场轮牧上叠加多个物种。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a company called Pasture Bird.
zh: 这是一家叫 Pasture Bird 的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were a big catalyst for me to really getting obsessed with this idea.
zh: 它们是让我真正对这个想法着迷的一大催化剂。

speaker: Unknown
en: What they did is took your normal chicken house, put it up on big wheels, and automated the movement so it creeps its width every 24 hours across pasture.
zh: 它们做的是把普通的鸡舍装上大轮子，并实现移动自动化，让它每 24 小时在牧场上爬行移动一个自身的宽度。

speaker: Unknown
en: The reason you can do it this scientifically with chickens is because they don't actually get most of their nutrients from the grass.
zh: 之所以能用鸡这样做并且如此科学，是因为它们实际上并不从草里获取大部分营养。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to supplement them with grain feed because chickens are omnivores, not quite just herbivores.
zh: 你必须用谷物饲料补充它们，因为鸡是杂食动物，不完全是草食动物。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can just inch this coop across the grass, giving them fertile land to grow on.
zh: 所以你可以把这个鸡舍一寸寸地移过草地，给它们肥沃的土地去生长。

speaker: Unknown
en: The nitrogen from their droppings actually help
zh: 它们粪便中的氮实际上有助于

speaker: Unknown
en: As a manure or as a fertilizer for the grass itself.
zh: 作为粪肥或作为草本身的肥料。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's an added benefit here when you stack the ruminants with the chickens.
zh: 而当你把反刍动物和鸡叠加在一起时，还有一个额外的好处。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you run your ruminants first, they sort of cut off the top of the grass and the chickens come behind them and peck out the parasites from their droppings and it reduces the parasite load overall across your farm, which reduces the medication expense you have to actually pay to keep your animals healthy.
zh: 如果你先放牧你的反刍动物，它们会切掉草的顶部，然后鸡跟在它们后面，从它们的粪便中啄出寄生虫，这会降低整个农场的寄生虫负荷，从而减少你为保持动物健康而实际需要支付的药物费用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And over term you have a more robust seed stock or breeding stock so that you can have stronger animals over time that require fewer interventions and can be left alone to just eat grass and turn into meat eventually.
zh: 长期来看，你会有更强健的种子畜群或种畜，这样随着时间推移你会有更强壮的动物，需要更少的干预，可以放着不管，只吃草，最终变成肉。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the three things I really hope you all take away from this talk is one, I think we need to find big real world physical problems that we can solve that require multivariate analysis and not quite yes or no decisions.
zh: 所以我真心希望大家从这次演讲中带走的三个要点是：第一，我认为我们需要找到可以用多变量分析解决的重大现实物理问题，而不是非此即彼的是/否决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are
zh: 有

speaker: Unknown
en: Lots of problems out there that don't actually have deterministic solutions.
zh: 很多问题实际上并没有确定性的解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: I hear a lot of engineers talk about how we turn LLMs into deterministic processes, and my contention is actually there's a lot of problems that you can't solve with deterministic algorithms.
zh: 我听到很多工程师谈论我们如何把 LLM 变成确定性流程，而我的主张实际上是，有很多问题是确定性算法无法解决的。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is one of them.
zh: 这就是其中之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a multivariate analysis.
zh: 它是一种多变量分析。

speaker: Unknown
en: There isn't a next best paddock to move to.
zh: 并不存在一个可以搬过去的次优围场。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's just your best guess on where you think they should go.
zh: 只有你对自己认为它们应该去哪里的最佳猜测。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think if we can take systems like that, these multi-data input systems, and drop an LLM in the center to actually reason over the data and at least make a suggestion that the human can confirm or deny, we can really start to scale systems like this that are very much restricted by the farmer's ability to scale their own labor, their own decision-making power, and really give them the tools that they need to grow their operations to hopefully
zh: 而且我认为，如果我们能拿这样的系统，这些多数据输入系统，把一个 LLM 放在中心去对数据进行真正的推理，并至少给出一个人类可以确认或否决的建议，我们就能真正开始扩展这类系统——这类系统目前深受农民扩展自己劳动、自己决策能力的限制——并真正给他们所需的工具去扩大他们的经营，希望能

speaker: Unknown
en: I think all animals could be raised on grass if we solve these problems.
zh: 我认为，如果我们解决这些问题，所有动物都可以在草地上饲养。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the last one is maybe you can come help me solve some of these problems.
zh: 最后一点是，也许你可以来帮我解决其中的一些问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The number one problem is actually just giving the agents the context they need, gathering the data, packaging that data, and then presenting it in a way that the LLN can reason over.
zh: 头号问题实际上就是给智能体提供它们所需的上下文，收集数据，打包这些数据，然后以一种 LLM 可以推理的方式呈现出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what we do over at Firecrawl.
zh: 这就是我们在 Firecrawl 所做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you're not thinking big enough.
zh: 所以你们的格局还不够大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Firecrawl is where we're building the context layer for AI, and I hope you can come build it with us.
zh: Firecrawl 是我们在为 AI 构建上下文层的地方，我希望你能来和我们一起构建它。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're hiring.
zh: 我们在招人。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here's all the job postings we currently have.
zh: 这是我们目前所有的职位招聘。

speaker: Unknown
en: Go to our website.
zh: 去我们的网站看看。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe find one that works out for you.
zh: 也许能找到适合你的一个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Reach out to me.
zh: 联系我。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'd love to have more people trying to figure out how we get data off the web to solve some more of these complex problems and present that data as context to these AI agents.
zh: 我们很乐意有更多人一起来研究如何从网络上获取数据，以解决更多这类复杂问题，并将这些数据作为上下文呈现给这些 AI 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And perhaps we can make the world a better place.
zh: 也许我们可以让世界变得更美好。

speaker: Unknown
en: My name's Cody.
zh: 我叫 Cody。

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenPasture is my open source project.
zh: OpenPasture 是我的开源项目。

speaker: Unknown
en: Firecrawl is where I do my day-to-day life, and these are my socials.
zh: Firecrawl 是我日常工作的地方，这些是我的社交账号。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll hang around for a little bit.
zh: 我会再逗留一会儿。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'd love to chat more about animals, cows, birds, all you like.
zh: 我很乐意多聊聊动物、牛、鸟，随你喜欢。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you very much for coming.
zh: 非常感谢各位的到来。
